title: Mining Architectural Models in the Wild: A Curated Dataset of AADL Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.18566v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Empirical research on software architecture maintenance and evolution is hindered by the scarcity of large-scale, validated, and richly annotated model datasets. Existing benchmarks are limited in scale, provide only model-level annotations, or lack alignment with reference architectures, thereby restricting reproducible studies of architectural reuse, conformance, and AI-driven analysis. To address this gap, we present A3D, a curated dataset of 1,115 Architecture Analysis and Design Language (AADL) models mined from public GitHub repositories and validated with the OSATE tool. The dataset spans 7 generic domains and 52 specific-problem clusters, and provides two annotation layers: (i) domain- and problem-level labels, which capture different model aggregation criteria, and (ii) component-level mappings to three reference architectures, which have been externally validated through a user study. Models are released in AADL and JSON format

translated_title: 在真实环境中挖掘架构模型：一个精选的AADL模型数据集
translated_abstract: 软件架构维护与演化的实证研究一直受到缺乏大规模、经过验证且具有丰富标注的模型数据集的阻碍。现有的基准数据集规模有限、仅提供模型级别的标注，或缺乏与参考架构的对齐，从而限制了架构复用、一致性检查以及AI驱动分析的可复现研究。为填补这一空白，我们提出了A3D，一个包含1,115个架构分析与设计语言（AADL）模型的精选数据集，这些模型从公开的GitHub仓库中挖掘，并通过OSATE工具进行验证。该数据集覆盖7个通用领域和52个特定问题集群，并提供两个标注层：（i）领域和问题级别的标签，捕捉不同的模型聚合标准；（ii）到三个参考架构的组件级别映射，这些映射已通过用户研究进行外部验证。所有模型以AADL和JSON格式发布。
tldr: 该论文提出了A3D数据集——一个从GitHub挖掘、经OSATE验证、覆盖7个领域和52个问题集群、并具有领域/问题标签与参考架构组件映射双标注层的1,115个AADL模型精选数据集，填补了软件架构实证研究中大规模标注数据集的空白。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces A3D, a curated dataset of 1,115 AADL models mined from GitHub and validated with OSATE, featuring dual annotation layers (domain/problem labels and component-level mappings to reference architectures) that fills the gap of large-scale annotated datasets for empirical software architecture research.
